attributes.board_name: DC Board of Audiology and Speech-Language Pathology (DC Health)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved programs that contribute to professional competence, e.g. from SLHA-DC or other state speech-language-hearing associations, AAA, ASHA and its approved providers, ACCME-accredited providers (Category I), IACET providers, Joint Commission-accredited health care organizations, the International Hearing Society; accredited college courses, seminars and workshops.
rules.new_licensee_rule: CE is not required for the first renewal after the initial license.
rules.audit_note: Random audit of at least 10% of active licensees; proof due within 30 days of notice.

topics.who: 10% of total CE in public health priorities published by the DC Health Director (list effective Oct 1, 2025)

rules.notes: 20 hours in the 2 years before expiration for SLPs and audiologists. Dual SLP + audiology licensees: 30 hours incl. 1 ethics, 2 LGBTQ, 5 hours in each discipline and 10% (3 hours) public health priorities. Since June 2024 DC Health moves licenses to birth-month expiry (odd/even year by birth year); during this one-time transition the Board accepts 50% of CE for licensees with less than 2 years on their term, but the 2 LGBTQ hours and 10% public health priorities still apply.
rules.rule_quote: 7906.2 To qualify for the renewal of a license, an applicant shall have completed, during the two (2)-year period preceding the date the license expires, twenty (20) hours of approved continuing education, which shall include the following:

rules.new_licensee_rule: CE is not required for the first renewal.

topics.who: 10% of total CE in DC Health public health priorities

rules.notes: Speech-language pathology assistants and audiology assistants are licensed by the same Board; 10 CEs per renewal period.
rules.rule_quote: • Speech-Language Pathology Assistant - Ten (10) CEs which shall include one (1) CE in ethics, two (2) CE in LGBTQ, and 10% (1 hours) of Public Health Priorities.
